source.text: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹראֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David, a psalm. God of my praise, do not be silent.

en.L: For the director. Of David. A psalm. God of my praise, do not be silent.
en.B: For the music director. Of David. A psalm. God whom I praise, do not keep silent.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song by David. God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one I praise. Do not stay silent!

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. De David. Un psaume. Dieu de ma louange, ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tais pas.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Un psaume. Dieu que je loue, ne reste pas silencieux.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David. Mon Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je loue. Ne reste pas sans rien dire !

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Ee Mungu wa sifa yangu, usinyamaze.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Ee Mungu ninayekusifu, usikae kimya.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye ninayekusifu. Usinyamaze!

es.L: Al director del coro. De David. Salmo. Oh Dios de mi alabanza, no calles.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David. Salmo. Dios a quien alabo, no te quedes callado.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Canto de David. Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres a quien alabo. ¡No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quedes en silencio!

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]. Của Đa-vít. [Một] thi thiên. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của sự ca ngợi tôi, xin đừng im lặng.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Thi thiên của Đa-vít. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng tôi ca ngợi, xin đừng làm thinh.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Bài ca của Đa-vít. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tôi ca ngợi. Xin đừng im lặng!

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: God of my praise: the God I praise
decisions.reason: God is the one the psalmist praises, the subject of all his praise (Deuteronomy 10:21). The psalm ends with that praise (verse 30).

decisions.choice: do not be silent: act, speak up for me
decisions.reason: God's silence is his not acting; the psalmist asks him to speak in his defense, as the liars speak against him (28:1; 83:2).

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: lamnatseach is "Au chef de chœur" (Literal, Balanced) and "Pour le chef des musiciens" (Readable), for Psalms 105–118
decisions.reason: The word names the one who leads the temple music (meaning decision m2). The French follows the terms set for the whole of Psalms, so that every title reads the same.

decisions.choice: Al director del coro (L, B); Para el director de la música (R); Salmo (L, B); Canto (R)
decisions.reason: Lamnatseach names the one who led the temple music, and mizmor is a song sung to music. Spanish follows the English levels and the other psalm titles: "director del coro" and "Salmo" at Literal and Balanced, "director de la música" and "Canto" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]" (L), "Cho nhạc trưởng" (B), "Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc" (R), with "thi thiên" (L, B) and "Bài ca" (R), as the published Psalm 139:1
decisions.reason: The terms note follows the published Psalm 139 for the director line and the titles. |

source.text: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] mouth of [the] wicked and [the] mouth of deceit against me they have opened; they have spoken with me [with] a tongue of falsehood.

en.L: For [the] mouth of [the] wicked and [the] mouth of deceit they have opened against me; they have spoken with me [with] a tongue of falsehood.
en.B: For the wicked have opened deceitful mouths against me; they speak to me with lies on their tongues.
en.R: Evil people are attacking me with lies. Everything they say to me is false.

fr.L: Car une bouche de méchant et une bouche de tromperie, ils [les] ont ouvertes contre moi ; ils m’ont parlé [avec] une langue de mensonge.
fr.B: Car les méchants ont ouvert contre moi des bouches trompeuses ; ils me parlent avec le mensonge sur la langue.
fr.R: Des gens mauvais m’attaquent avec des mensonges. Tout ce qu’ils me disent est faux.

sw.L: Kwa maana kinywa cha mwovu na kinywa cha hila wamekifungua dhidi yangu; wamesema nami [kwa] ulimi wa uongo.
sw.B: Kwa maana waovu wamefungua vinywa vya hila dhidi yangu; wanasema nami kwa ndimi za uongo.
sw.R: Watu waovu wananishambulia kwa uongo. Kila wanachoniambia ni uongo.

es.L: Porque boca de malvado y boca de engaño han abierto contra mí; han hablado conmigo [con] lengua de mentira.
es.B: Porque los malvados han abierto contra mí bocas mentirosas; me hablan con la mentira en la lengua.
es.R: Gente malvada me ataca con mentiras. Todo lo que me dicen es falso.

vi.L: Vì miệng kẻ ác và miệng dối trá chúng đã mở ra nghịch cùng tôi; chúng đã nói với tôi [bằng] lưỡi giả dối.
vi.B: Vì kẻ ác đã há miệng dối trá nghịch cùng tôi; chúng nói với tôi bằng lưỡi đầy dối gian.
vi.R: Những kẻ ác đang tấn công tôi bằng những lời dối trá. Mọi điều chúng nói với tôi đều là giả dối.

decisions.choice: opened a mouth against me: attacked with words
decisions.reason: The enemies' weapon is speech: lies, hatred and accusation (verses 2-5, 20, 29). The psalm asks God not to be silent while they speak.

decisions.choice: spoken with me: spoken to me, or against me
decisions.reason: The words ("with me") can mean speaking to him face to face, or speaking about him.

decisions.choice: for: the reason for the prayer
decisions.reason: God must not stay silent because the liars are not silent.

decisions.choice: "chúng" for the singer's enemies, and "hắn" for the one enemy he prays against in verses 6-19
decisions.reason: The singer speaks of those who attack him without the respect "họ" would carry, as in the earlier Psalms; "hắn" carries the same tone for one man. |

source.text: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [with] words of hatred they have surrounded me, and they have fought against me without cause.

en.L: And with words of hatred they have surrounded me, and they have fought against me without cause.
en.B: They have hemmed me in with hateful words and attacked me for no reason.
en.R: They surround me and say hateful things. They attack me, though I have done nothing to them.

fr.L: Et de paroles de haine ils m’ont entouré, et ils m’ont combattu sans raison.
fr.B: Ils m’ont cerné de paroles haineuses et m’ont attaqué sans motif.
fr.R: Ils m’entourent et disent des choses pleines de haine. Ils m’attaquent, alors que je ne leur ai rien fait.

sw.L: Na kwa maneno ya chuki wamenizunguka, wamepigana nami bila sababu.
sw.B: Wamenizingira kwa maneno ya chuki na kunishambulia bila sababu.
sw.R: Wananizunguka na kusema maneno ya chuki. Wananishambulia, ingawa sijawatendea lolote.

es.L: Y con palabras de odio me han rodeado, y han luchado contra mí sin causa.
es.B: Me han cercado con palabras llenas de odio y me han atacado sin motivo.
es.R: Me rodean y dicen cosas llenas de odio. Me atacan, aunque yo no les he hecho nada.

vi.L: Và bằng những lời căm ghét chúng đã vây quanh tôi, và chúng đã tấn công tôi vô cớ.
vi.B: Chúng bủa vây tôi bằng những lời căm ghét và tấn công tôi vô cớ.
vi.R: Chúng vây quanh tôi và nói những lời đầy căm ghét. Chúng tấn công tôi, dù tôi chẳng làm gì hại chúng.

decisions.choice: surrounded me: closed in like an army
decisions.reason: Their words are pictured as soldiers besieging him (22:13, 17).

decisions.choice: without cause: for nothing
decisions.reason: The word (chinnam) means free, for no reason: he gave them no cause (35:7; 69:5).

source.text: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In return for my love they accuse me, and I [am] prayer.

en.L: In return for my love they accuse me, but I [am] prayer.
en.B: They repay my love by accusing me, yet I go on praying.
en.R: I showed them love, but they accuse me in return. Even so, I keep praying.

fr.L: En retour de mon amour ils m’accusent, mais moi, [je suis] prière.
fr.B: Ils répondent à mon amour par des accusations, et pourtant je continue de prier.
fr.R: Je leur ai montré de l’amour, mais en retour ils m’accusent. Malgré tout, je continue à prier.

sw.L: Badala ya upendo wangu wananishtaki, lakini mimi [ni] maombi.
sw.B: Wanalipa upendo wangu kwa kunishtaki, lakini mimi naendelea kuomba.
sw.R: Niliwaonyesha upendo, lakini wao wananishtaki. Hata hivyo, naendelea kuomba.

es.L: A cambio de mi amor me acusan, pero yo [soy] oración.
es.B: Me pagan mi amor acusándome, y yo sigo orando.
es.R: Yo les mostré amor, pero ellos me acusan a cambio. Aun así, sigo orando.

vi.L: Đáp lại tình thương của tôi chúng tố cáo tôi, nhưng tôi [là] sự cầu nguyện.
vi.B: Chúng đáp trả tình thương của tôi bằng lời tố cáo, nhưng tôi vẫn cứ cầu nguyện.
vi.R: Tôi đã tỏ lòng thương chúng, nhưng chúng lại tố cáo tôi. Dù vậy, tôi vẫn tiếp tục cầu nguyện.

decisions.choice: accuse me: act as my accuser
decisions.reason: The verb (satan) is to oppose as an adversary, especially in court. The same word comes as "accuser" in verses 6, 20 and 29: the psalm is a case at law.

decisions.choice: I am prayer: I give myself to prayer
decisions.reason: The short phrase ("and I prayer") means that all he does is pray, as 120:7 says "I am peace". It may also mean that he prays for them.

decisions.choice: I go on praying (B); I keep praying (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m2).

decisions.choice: yo [soy] oración
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "and I, prayer". Literal keeps the bare phrase with the supplied verb in brackets, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say that he goes on praying.

source.text: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And they have put on me evil in place of good, and hatred in place of my love.

en.L: And they have laid on me evil in return for good, and hatred in return for my love.
en.B: They hand me evil for the good I did, and hatred in exchange for my love.
en.R: I did good to them, but they do evil to me. I loved them, but they hate me.

fr.L: Et ils ont mis sur moi le mal en retour du bien, et la haine en retour de mon amour.
fr.B: Ils me rendent le mal pour le bien que j’ai fait, et la haine en échange de mon amour.
fr.R: Je leur ai fait du bien, mais ils me font du mal. Je les ai aimés, mais ils me détestent.

sw.L: Wameniwekea mabaya badala ya mema, na chuki badala ya upendo wangu.
sw.B: Wananilipa mabaya kwa mema niliyowatendea, na chuki badala ya upendo wangu.
sw.R: Niliwatendea mema, lakini wao wananitendea mabaya. Niliwapenda, lakini wao wananichukia.

es.L: Y han puesto sobre mí mal a cambio de bien, y odio a cambio de mi amor.
es.B: Me devuelven mal por el bien que hice, y odio a cambio de mi amor.
es.R: Yo les hice bien, pero ellos me hacen mal. Yo los amé, pero ellos me odian.

vi.L: Và chúng đã đặt trên tôi điều ác thay cho điều thiện, và sự căm ghét thay cho tình thương của tôi.
vi.B: Chúng lấy điều ác trả cho điều tốt tôi đã làm, và lấy sự căm ghét đáp lại tình thương của tôi.
vi.R: Tôi làm điều tốt cho chúng, nhưng chúng làm điều ác cho tôi. Tôi thương chúng, nhưng chúng ghét tôi.

decisions.choice: laid on me: repaid me with
decisions.reason: The verb (sim) is to set or put: they have charged him with evil in return for good.

decisions.choice: evil for good
decisions.reason: The same complaint is made in 35:12 and 38:21. Returning evil for good is condemned in Proverbs 17:13.

source.text: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Appoint over him a wicked [one], and let an accuser stand at his right hand.

en.L: Appoint over him a wicked [one], and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
en.B: Put someone wicked in charge of him; may an accuser take his stand at his right side.
en.R: Let an evil person be his judge. Let someone stand beside him in court to accuse him.

fr.L: Établis sur lui un méchant, et qu’un accusateur se tienne à sa droite.
fr.B: Place au-dessus de lui quelqu’un de méchant ; qu’un accusateur se poste à sa droite.
fr.R: Que quelqu’un de mauvais soit son juge. Que quelqu’un se tienne à côté de lui au tribunal pour l’accuser.

sw.L: Weka juu yake mtu mwovu, na mshtaki asimame mkono wake wa kuume.
sw.B: Mweke mtu mwovu awe juu yake; mshtaki na asimame upande wake wa kuume.
sw.R: Mtu mwovu na awe hakimu wake. Mtu fulani na asimame kando yake mahakamani kumshtaki.

es.L: Pon sobre él a un malvado, y que un acusador esté a su derecha.
es.B: Pon a alguien malvado sobre él; que un acusador se ponga a su lado derecho.
es.R: Que una persona malvada sea su juez. Que alguien se ponga a su lado en el tribunal para acusarlo.

vi.L: Xin lập trên hắn một kẻ ác, và nguyện một kẻ cáo buộc đứng bên tay phải hắn.
vi.B: Xin đặt một kẻ gian ác cai quản hắn; nguyện một kẻ tố cáo đứng bên phải hắn.
vi.R: Xin để một kẻ ác làm quan xét hắn. Xin để có người đứng bên cạnh hắn tại tòa để tố cáo hắn.

decisions.choice: a prayer for judgment
decisions.reason: Verses 6-20 ask God to punish the accuser and to let his own curses fall on him. The psalmist does not take revenge himself; he has prayed (verse 4) and hands the case to God, the judge, asking for justice in God's court (Romans 12:19). The New Testament applies verse 8 to Judas (Acts 1:20).

decisions.choice: him: one enemy, or each of them
alternatives: verses 6-19 are the enemies' curses against the psalmist, quoted
decisions.reason: Verses 2-5 speak of the enemies as "they"; verses 6-19 speak of one man, perhaps their leader or each of them in turn. Some read verses 6-19 as the curses the enemies spoke against the psalmist, quoted by him; but the Hebrew gives no sign of a quotation, and verse 20 calls all this the wages of the accusers.

decisions.choice: an accuser: an opponent at law
decisions.reason: The word (satan) is an adversary, here an accuser in a trial (verse 4). In Zechariah 3:1 "the accuser" stands at the right hand of the high priest to accuse him. The ancient Greek translation has "the devil".

decisions.choice: at his right hand: the accuser's place in court
decisions.reason: In a trial the accuser stood at the right of the accused (Zechariah 3:1). In verse 31 it is God who stands at the right hand of the needy.

decisions.choice: Let an evil person be his judge
alternatives: Appoint a wicked one over him
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of "appoint over him" in a trial.

source.text: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: When he is judged, let him come out guilty, and his prayer let it become sin.

en.L: When he is judged, let him come out guilty, and let his prayer become sin.
en.B: When he is tried, may the verdict be guilty, and may his very prayer count as sin.
en.R: When he goes on trial, let the court find him guilty. Let even his prayers count as sin.

fr.L: Quand il sera jugé, qu’il sorte coupable, et que sa prière devienne péché.
fr.B: Quand on le jugera, que le verdict soit : coupable, et que sa prière même compte comme un péché.
fr.R: Quand il passera en jugement, que le tribunal le déclare coupable. Que même ses prières comptent comme des péchés.

sw.L: Atakapohukumiwa, na atoke akiwa na hatia, na maombi yake yawe dhambi.
sw.B: Anaposhtakiwa, hukumu na iwe kwamba ana hatia, na hata maombi yake yahesabiwe kuwa dhambi.
sw.R: Anaposhtakiwa, mahakama na imwone kuwa na hatia. Hata maombi yake na yahesabiwe kuwa dhambi.

es.L: Cuando sea juzgado, que salga culpable, y que su oración se vuelva pecado.
es.B: Cuando lo juzguen, que el veredicto sea «culpable», y que hasta su oración cuente como pecado.
es.R: Cuando lo lleven a juicio, que el tribunal lo declare culpable. Que hasta sus oraciones cuenten como pecado.

vi.L: Khi hắn bị xét xử, nguyện hắn ra [tòa] mang tội, và nguyện lời cầu nguyện của hắn trở thành tội lỗi.
vi.B: Khi hắn bị xét xử, nguyện bản án là có tội, và nguyện chính lời cầu xin của hắn bị kể là tội.
vi.R: Khi hắn bị đưa ra tòa, xin để tòa xử hắn có tội. Xin để ngay cả lời cầu nguyện của hắn cũng bị kể là tội.

decisions.choice: his prayer: his plea
decisions.reason: The word (tefillah) is prayer to God; here it may be his plea for mercy in court. Either way the plea of a guilty man who showed no mercy is to be refused.

decisions.choice: come out guilty: leave the court condemned
decisions.reason: To "come out" of a trial is to be declared guilty or innocent (17:2).

source.text: יִֽהְיֽוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let his days be few; his office let another take.

en.L: Let his days be few; let another take his office.
en.B: May his life be short, and may someone else take over his position.
en.R: Let his life be cut short. Let someone else take over his place as a leader.

fr.L: Que ses jours soient peu nombreux ; que sa charge, un autre la prenne.
fr.B: Que sa vie soit courte, et que quelqu’un d’autre prenne sa place.
fr.R: Que sa vie soit raccourcie. Que quelqu’un d’autre prenne sa place de responsable.

sw.L: Siku zake na ziwe chache; cheo chake na akichukue mwingine.
sw.B: Maisha yake na yawe mafupi, na mtu mwingine achukue nafasi yake.
sw.R: Maisha yake na yakatizwe mapema. Mtu mwingine na achukue nafasi yake ya uongozi.

es.L: Que sean pocos sus días; que otro tome su cargo.
es.B: Que su vida sea corta, y que otro ocupe su puesto.
es.R: Que su vida se acabe pronto. Que otro ocupe su lugar como líder.

vi.L: Nguyện số ngày của hắn ít ỏi; nguyện kẻ khác lấy chức vụ của hắn.
vi.B: Nguyện đời hắn ngắn ngủi, và nguyện người khác thay thế chức vị của hắn.
vi.R: Xin để đời hắn bị cắt ngắn. Xin để người khác thay chỗ hắn làm người lãnh đạo.

decisions.choice: Acts 1:20: another takes Judas's place
decisions.reason: Peter quotes this line, with 69:26, of Judas after his death, and the apostles choose Matthias to take his place (Acts 1:20-26).

decisions.choice: his office: his post of oversight
decisions.reason: The word (pequddah) is an appointed charge or office (Numbers 4:16). It can also mean goods in someone's care.

decisions.choice: his days be few: may he die early
decisions.reason: A short life was a sign of judgment (55:24).

source.text: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Let his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

en.L: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
en.B: May his children lose their father and his wife be left a widow.
en.R: Let his children be left without a father, and let his wife become a widow.

fr.L: Que ses enfants soient orphelins, et sa femme veuve.
fr.B: Que ses enfants perdent leur père et que sa femme reste veuve.
fr.R: Que ses enfants se retrouvent sans père, et que sa femme devienne veuve.

sw.L: Watoto wake na wawe yatima, na mke wake mjane.
sw.B: Watoto wake na wapoteze baba yao, na mke wake abaki mjane.
sw.R: Watoto wake na wabaki bila baba, na mke wake awe mjane.

es.L: Que sus hijos queden huérfanos, y su mujer viuda.
es.B: Que sus hijos se queden sin padre y su esposa quede viuda.
es.R: Que sus hijos se queden sin padre, y que su esposa se quede viuda.

vi.L: Nguyện con cái hắn mồ côi cha, và vợ hắn góa bụa.
vi.B: Nguyện con cái hắn mất cha và vợ hắn phải góa bụa.
vi.R: Xin để con cái hắn mồ côi cha, và để vợ hắn trở thành góa phụ.

decisions.choice: his family shares his fate
decisions.reason: A man's household stood or fell with him (Exodus 20:5; Joshua 7:24). He made others poor and helpless (verse 16); the prayer is that he and his receive the same.

source.text: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And wandering let them wander, his children, and let them beg, and let them seek [food] from their ruins.

en.L: And let his children wander and wander, and beg, and seek [food] from their ruins.
en.B: May his children roam about as beggars, searching for food far from their ruined homes.
en.R: Let his children wander from place to place, begging. Let them search for food far from the ruins of their homes.

fr.L: Et que ses enfants errent et errent, et mendient, et cherchent [leur pain] loin de leurs ruines.
fr.B: Que ses enfants vagabondent en mendiant, cherchant de quoi manger loin de leurs maisons en ruine.
fr.R: Que ses enfants aillent d’un endroit à l’autre en mendiant. Qu’ils cherchent de la nourriture loin des ruines de leurs maisons.

sw.L: Na watoto wake watangetange na kutangatanga, na waombe, na watafute [chakula] mbali na magofu yao.
sw.B: Watoto wake na wazunguke wakiomba-omba, wakitafuta chakula mbali na nyumba zao zilizobomoka.
sw.R: Watoto wake na watangetange huku na huko wakiomba. Na watafute chakula mbali na magofu ya nyumba zao.

es.L: Y que anden errantes, errantes, sus hijos, y mendiguen, y busquen [comida] lejos de sus ruinas.
es.B: Que sus hijos vaguen como mendigos, buscando comida lejos de sus casas en ruinas.
es.R: Que sus hijos anden de un lugar a otro pidiendo limosna. Que busquen comida lejos de las ruinas de sus casas.

vi.L: Và nguyện con cái hắn lang thang và lang thang, và đi xin, và tìm [thức ăn] từ những nơi đổ nát của chúng.
vi.B: Nguyện con cái hắn đi lang thang ăn xin, tìm thức ăn xa khỏi những ngôi nhà đổ nát của mình.
vi.R: Xin để con cái hắn lang thang hết nơi này đến nơi khác mà ăn xin. Xin để chúng tìm thức ăn xa khỏi đống đổ nát của nhà mình.

decisions.choice: wander and wander: always on the move
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis: they will wander without rest, like Cain (Genesis 4:12).

decisions.choice: seek from their ruins: search for food away from home
alternatives: let them be driven out of their ruins (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "let them seek from their ruins". The ancient Greek translation read a word very like it, "let them be driven out". Both describe children forced out of a ruined home to beg.

decisions.choice: food
decisions.reason: What beggars seek is food; Literal brackets it.

source.text: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let a creditor ensnare all that [belongs] to him, and let strangers plunder his labor.

en.L: Let the creditor seize all that [belongs] to him, and let strangers plunder [the fruit of] his toil.
en.B: May the moneylender snatch up all he owns, and strangers carry off what he worked for.
en.R: Let the people he owes money to take everything he has. Let strangers steal all he worked for.

fr.L: Que le créancier saisisse tout ce qui [est] à lui, et que des étrangers pillent [le fruit de] son labeur.
fr.B: Que le prêteur s’empare de tout ce qu’il possède, et que des étrangers emportent ce qu’il a gagné par son travail.
fr.R: Que ceux à qui il doit de l’argent prennent tout ce qu’il a. Que des étrangers volent tout ce qu’il a gagné en travaillant.

sw.L: Mdai na anase vyote alivyo navyo, na wageni wateke [matunda ya] kazi yake.
sw.B: Mkopeshaji na anyakue vyote alivyo navyo, na wageni wachukue alichokifanyia kazi.
sw.R: Watu aliokopa fedha kwao na wachukue kila kitu alicho nacho. Wageni na waibe vyote alivyovifanyia kazi.

es.L: Que el acreedor se apodere de todo lo que [es] suyo, y que extraños saqueen [el fruto de] su trabajo.
es.B: Que el prestamista atrape todo lo que tiene, y que extraños se lleven lo que ganó con su esfuerzo.
es.R: Que las personas a quienes debe dinero se lleven todo lo que tiene. Que unos extraños le roben todo aquello por lo que trabajó.

vi.L: Nguyện chủ nợ chiếm lấy mọi thứ thuộc về hắn, và nguyện người lạ cướp [thành quả] lao nhọc của hắn.
vi.B: Nguyện kẻ cho vay chộp lấy mọi thứ hắn có, và người lạ cướp đi những gì hắn làm ra.
vi.R: Xin để những người hắn mắc nợ lấy hết mọi thứ hắn có. Xin để người lạ cướp đi mọi thứ hắn đã làm ra.

decisions.choice: let the creditor seize: lay hold of, as in a trap
decisions.reason: The verb (naqash) is to lay a snare; the creditor (nosheh) is one who has lent and now takes everything in payment (2 Kings 4:1).

decisions.choice: his labor: what he has worked for
decisions.reason: The word (yegia') is toil and what it produces (128:2).

source.text: אַל־יְהִי־ל֭וֹמֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Let there not be to him one who extends loyal love, and let there not be one who shows favor to his fatherless [children].

en.L: Let there be no one to extend loyal love to him, and let there be no one to show favor to his fatherless [children].
en.B: May no one keep showing him loyal love, and no one take pity on his orphaned children.
en.R: Let no one be kind to him. Let no one care for his children when they have no father.

fr.L: Qu’il n’y ait personne pour lui prolonger [son] amour loyal, et qu’il n’y ait personne pour faire grâce à ses orphelins.
fr.B: Que personne ne continue à lui montrer un amour fidèle, et que personne n’ait pitié de ses enfants orphelins.
fr.R: Que personne ne soit bon pour lui. Que personne ne s’occupe de ses enfants quand ils n’auront plus de père.

sw.L: Asiwepo mtu wa kumdumishia upendo usiokoma, wala asiwepo wa kuwahurumia yatima wake.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asiendelee kumwonyesha upendo usiokoma, wala yeyote asiwahurumie watoto wake yatima.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asimtendee wema. Mtu yeyote asiwajali watoto wake wanapokuwa bila baba.

es.L: Que no haya quien le extienda amor leal, y que no haya quien se compadezca de sus huérfanos.
es.B: Que nadie le siga mostrando amor fiel, ni nadie tenga piedad de sus hijos huérfanos.
es.R: Que nadie sea bondadoso con él. Que nadie cuide de sus hijos cuando se queden sin padre.

vi.L: Nguyện không có ai tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với hắn, và nguyện không có ai thương xót những [đứa con] mồ côi của hắn.
vi.B: Nguyện không ai còn tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với hắn, và không ai thương xót những đứa con mồ côi của hắn.
vi.R: Xin đừng để ai tử tế với hắn. Xin đừng để ai chăm sóc con cái hắn khi chúng không còn cha.

decisions.choice: extend loyal love: keep up kindness
decisions.reason: Loyal love (chesed) is here the faithful kindness people owe each other. He did not remember to show it (verse 16), and the prayer is that none be shown to him. To "extend" (mashakh) is to draw it out, to keep it going (36:11).

decisions.choice: be kind
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plain word for loyal love between people.

decisions.choice: "asimtendee wema" (let no one do him good) at Readable
decisions.reason: Here *ḥesed* is kindness from one person to another, and the English Readable says "be kind". Readable follows that sense in plain words rather than repeating the term used for God's love; Literal and Balanced keep "upendo usiokoma".

decisions.choice: bondadoso
decisions.reason: Here ḥesed is the kindness one person shows another, not God's covenant love; Readable says "bondadoso", as the English Readable says "kind", and Literal and Balanced keep "amor leal".

decisions.choice: "tử tế" (kind) at Readable for chesed between people; "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B)
alternatives: "tình thương không hề thay đổi" at Readable
decisions.reason: Here chesed is the loyal kindness one person shows another, not God's love; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable's "be kind". The same in verse 16. |

source.text: יְהִֽי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let his posterity be for cutting off; in another generation let their name be wiped out.

en.L: Let his posterity be for cutting off; in another generation let their name be blotted out.
en.B: May his line come to an end, their name erased within a generation.
en.R: Let his family line end, so that in the next generation no one is left to carry their name.

fr.L: Que sa postérité soit vouée au retranchement ; dans une autre génération, que leur nom soit effacé.
fr.B: Que sa descendance disparaisse, et que leur nom soit effacé en une génération.
fr.R: Que sa famille s’éteigne, et qu’à la génération suivante il ne reste personne pour porter leur nom.

sw.L: Wazao wake na wakatiliwe mbali; katika kizazi kingine jina lao na lifutwe.
sw.B: Ukoo wake na ukome, jina lao lifutwe ndani ya kizazi kimoja.
sw.R: Ukoo wake na ukome, ili katika kizazi kijacho asibaki mtu yeyote wa kulibeba jina lao.

es.L: Que su posteridad sea para ser cortada; en otra generación sea borrado el nombre de ellos.
es.B: Que su linaje llegue a su fin, y su nombre se borre en una sola generación.
es.R: Que su familia se acabe, y que en la siguiente generación no quede nadie que lleve su apellido.

vi.L: Nguyện dòng dõi hắn bị diệt mất; trong thế hệ sau nguyện tên của chúng bị xóa đi.
vi.B: Nguyện dòng dõi hắn bị tuyệt diệt, tên tuổi chúng bị xóa sạch trong một thế hệ.
vi.R: Xin để dòng họ hắn chấm dứt, đến nỗi thế hệ sau không còn ai mang tên của họ.

decisions.choice: their name wiped out: the family dies out
decisions.reason: A family's name lived on in its sons; to have it wiped out was the worst loss (Deuteronomy 25:6). "Their" is the name of his descendants.

decisions.choice: posterity: those who come after
decisions.reason: The word ('acharit) is the end or what comes after: his descendants, his future (37:37-38).

source.text: יִזָּכֵ֤ר׀עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to YHWH, and the sin of his mother let it not be wiped out.

en.L: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} keep in mind the guilt of his ancestors, and may his mother's sin never be erased.
en.R: Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remember the wrong his ancestors did, and never forget his mother's sin.

fr.L: Que la faute de ses pères soit rappelée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et que le péché de sa mère ne soit pas effacé.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} garde en mémoire la faute de ses ancêtres, et que le péché de sa mère ne soit jamais effacé.
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se souvienne du mal qu’ont fait ses ancêtres, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’oublie jamais le péché de sa mère.

sw.L: Uovu wa baba zake na ukumbukwe mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala dhambi ya mama yake isifutwe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na aukumbuke daima uovu wa babu zake, na dhambi ya mama yake isifutwe kamwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akumbuke mabaya waliyoyafanya babu zake, wala asisahau kamwe dhambi ya mama yake.

es.L: Que la iniquidad de sus padres sea recordada ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y que el pecado de su madre no sea borrado.
es.B: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tenga presente la culpa de sus antepasados, y que el pecado de su madre nunca se borre.
es.R: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se acuerde del mal que hicieron sus antepasados, y que nunca olvide el pecado de su madre.

vi.L: Nguyện sự gian ác của tổ phụ hắn được nhớ đến trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nguyện tội lỗi của mẹ hắn không bị xóa đi.
vi.B: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghi nhớ tội lỗi của tổ tiên hắn, và nguyện tội của mẹ hắn không bao giờ bị xóa bỏ.
vi.R: Xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhớ những điều sai trái tổ tiên hắn đã làm, và đừng bao giờ quên tội của mẹ hắn.

decisions.choice: the sins of the parents
decisions.reason: The prayer asks God to hold the family's guilt against the man, as the law warns for those who hate God (Exodus 20:5). Elsewhere each person bears his own sin (Ezekiel 18:20); here the psalmist leaves the judgment to God.

decisions.choice: remembered to the LORD: kept before him
decisions.reason: For God to remember sin is for him to act on it; for him to wipe it out is to forgive (51:3).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The fathers are the forebears of the family.

source.text: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד־יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them be before YHWH continually, and let him cut off from [the] earth their memory.

en.L: Let them be before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} continually, and may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cut off their memory from the earth.
en.B: May their sins stay always before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
en.R: Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} always keep their sins in mind, and let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} make the whole world forget them.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} continuellement, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} retranche de la terre leur souvenir.
fr.B: Que leurs péchés restent toujours devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} efface de la terre tout souvenir d’eux.
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} garde toujours leurs péchés en mémoire, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse que le monde entier les oublie.

sw.L: Na viwe mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} aikatilie mbali kumbukumbu yao duniani.
sw.B: Dhambi zao na zikae daima mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} afute kabisa kumbukumbu yao duniani.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na azikumbuke dhambi zao daima, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} aufanye ulimwengu wote uwasahau.

es.L: Que estén delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} continuamente, y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} corte de la tierra su memoria.
es.B: Que sus pecados estén siempre delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} borre de la tierra todo recuerdo de ellos.
es.R: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tenga siempre presentes sus pecados, y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haga que el mundo entero los olvide.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng ở trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} luôn luôn, và nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cắt đứt kỷ niệm về chúng khỏi mặt đất.
vi.B: Nguyện tội lỗi chúng luôn ở trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xóa sạch mọi kỷ niệm về chúng khỏi mặt đất.
vi.R: Xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} luôn ghi nhớ tội lỗi của chúng, và xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho cả thế gian quên chúng đi.

decisions.choice: them: the sins of verse 14
decisions.reason: "Let them be before the LORD" refers to the iniquity and sin of verse 14. "Their memory" is that of the man and his family.

decisions.choice: cut off their memory: 34:17
decisions.reason: The same words are used of evildoers in 34:17.

decisions.choice: their sins
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "them" refers to (m1).

source.text: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Because that he did not remember to do loyal love, and he pursued a poor and needy man and [the] disheartened of heart, to put [them] to death.

en.L: Because he did not remember to do loyal love, and he pursued a poor and needy {{gender:person|man}} and the crushed of heart, to put [them] to death.
en.B: For he never thought to show loyal love; he hounded the poor and needy and the heartbroken to their death.
en.R: He never cared about being kind. Instead he hunted down poor people who needed help and people whose hearts were broken, wanting to kill them.

fr.L: Parce qu’il ne s’est pas souvenu de pratiquer l’amour loyal, et qu’il a poursuivi {{gender:une personne pauvre et indigente|un homme pauvre et indigent}} et celui qui a le cœur brisé, pour [les] faire mourir.
fr.B: Car il n’a jamais pensé à montrer de l’amour fidèle ; il a traqué jusqu’à la mort le pauvre, l’indigent et celui qui a le cœur brisé.
fr.R: Il ne s’est jamais soucié d’être bon. Au contraire, il a pourchassé des pauvres qui avaient besoin d’aide et des gens au cœur brisé, parce qu’il voulait les tuer.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hakukumbuka kutenda upendo usiokoma, bali alimfuatia mtu maskini na mhitaji na aliyevunjika moyo, ili amwue.
sw.B: Kwa maana hakuwahi kufikiri kuonyesha upendo usiokoma; aliwawinda maskini na wahitaji na waliovunjika moyo mpaka kufa.
sw.R: Hakujali kamwe kuwatendea watu wema. Badala yake aliwawinda maskini waliohitaji msaada na watu waliovunjika moyo, akitaka kuwaua.

es.L: Porque no se acordó de hacer amor leal, y persiguió a {{gender:una persona pobre y necesitada|un hombre pobre y necesitado}} y al quebrantado de corazón, para dar[le] muerte.
es.B: Porque nunca pensó en mostrar amor fiel; acosó hasta la muerte al pobre, al necesitado y al de corazón quebrantado.
es.R: Nunca le importó ser bondadoso. Al contrario, perseguía a los pobres que necesitaban ayuda y a los que tenían el corazón roto, porque quería matarlos.

vi.L: Vì hắn đã không nhớ làm điều yêu thương thành tín, và hắn đã săn đuổi một người nghèo khó và thiếu thốn, và người có lòng tan nát, để giết [họ].
vi.B: Vì hắn chẳng bao giờ nghĩ đến việc tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín; hắn săn đuổi người nghèo khổ, người thiếu thốn và người có lòng tan vỡ cho đến chết.
vi.R: Hắn chẳng bao giờ quan tâm đến việc tử tế với ai. Trái lại, hắn săn lùng những người nghèo cần được giúp đỡ và những người có lòng tan vỡ, để giết họ.

decisions.choice: the reason: he showed no loyal love
decisions.reason: The judgment fits the deed. He showed no loyal love (chesed), so none is to be shown to him (verse 12); he loved cursing, so cursing comes to him (verse 17).

decisions.choice: disheartened of heart: crushed in spirit
decisions.reason: The word (nikh'eh) is broken or crushed; with "heart" it is someone whose spirit is crushed. The psalmist is himself "poor and needy" (verse 22).

decisions.choice: person (man)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "man" ('ish) here means anyone poor; the default says "person", with "man" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: being kind
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: {{gender:una persona pobre y necesitada|un hombre pobre y necesitado}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʾish here means any person. As the English Literal does, the gender setting gives "una persona" by default and "un hombre" as the alternative; the span takes in the whole phrase, since the adjectives agree with it.

decisions.choice: "một người" (a person) at Literal, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "person" or "man"; "người" already means either, so Vietnamese has no second form. |

source.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he loved cursing, and it came to him; and he did not delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

en.L: And he loved cursing, and it came to him; and he did not delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
en.B: He loved to curse, and the curse has come back on him; he had no wish to bless, and blessing has stayed far from him.
en.R: He loved to curse others, and now curses fall on him. He never wanted to bless anyone, and now no blessing comes to him.

fr.L: Et il a aimé la malédiction, et elle est venue sur lui ; et il n’a pas pris plaisir à la bénédiction, et elle s’est éloignée de lui.
fr.B: Il aimait maudire, et la malédiction est retombée sur lui ; il ne voulait pas bénir, et la bénédiction est restée loin de lui.
fr.R: Il aimait maudire les autres, et maintenant les malédictions tombent sur lui. Il ne voulait jamais bénir personne, et maintenant aucune bénédiction ne lui arrive.

sw.L: Alipenda kulaani, nako kukamjia; hakupendezwa na kubariki, nako kukawa mbali naye.
sw.B: Alipenda kulaani, na laana imemrudia; hakutaka kubariki, na baraka imekaa mbali naye.
sw.R: Alipenda kuwalaani wengine, na sasa laana zinamwangukia. Hakutaka kumbariki mtu yeyote, na sasa hakuna baraka inayomjia.

es.L: Y amó la maldición, y le vino; y no se complació en la bendición, y se alejó de él.
es.B: Le encantaba maldecir, y la maldición ha caído sobre él; no quiso bendecir, y la bendición se ha quedado lejos de él.
es.R: Le gustaba maldecir a otros, y ahora las maldiciones caen sobre él. Nunca quiso bendecir a nadie, y ahora no le llega ninguna bendición.

vi.L: Và hắn đã yêu sự rủa sả, và nó đã đến trên hắn; và hắn không ưa thích sự chúc phước, và nó đã xa khỏi hắn.
vi.B: Hắn thích rủa sả, nên lời rủa sả đã đổ lại trên hắn; hắn chẳng muốn chúc phước, nên phước lành đã lìa xa hắn.
vi.R: Hắn thích nguyền rủa người khác, và giờ đây những lời nguyền rủa đổ xuống trên hắn. Hắn chẳng bao giờ muốn chúc phước cho ai, và giờ đây không có phước lành nào đến với hắn.

decisions.choice: it came, it was far: what has happened to him
alternatives: let it come to him; let it be far from him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs say what has happened: the curse came, the blessing stayed away. The ancient translations read them as wishes, "let it come ... let it be far", continuing the prayer.

decisions.choice: curse and blessing return to the one who speaks them
decisions.reason: What he wished on others comes back on him (7:16-17; Proverbs 26:27). God promised Abraham to bless those who bless him and curse those who curse him (Genesis 12:3).

source.text: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put on cursing like his garment, and it came like water into his inner parts, and like oil into his bones.

en.L: And he clothed himself with cursing like his garment, and it came like water into his inner parts, and like oil into his bones.
en.B: He put on cursing as his clothing; it seeped like water into his inner being and soaked like oil deep into his bones.
en.R: Cursing was part of him, like the clothes he wore. It filled him the way water soaks in, the way oil sinks deep into the bones.

fr.L: Et il s’est revêtu de la malédiction comme de son vêtement, et elle est entrée comme de l’eau dans ses entrailles, et comme de l’huile dans ses os.
fr.B: Il s’est habillé de malédiction comme d’un vêtement ; elle a pénétré comme de l’eau au plus profond de lui et comme de l’huile jusque dans ses os.
fr.R: La malédiction faisait partie de lui, comme les habits qu’il portait. Elle l’a rempli comme l’eau qui pénètre, comme l’huile qui entre profondément dans les os.

sw.L: Alijivika laana kama vazi lake, nayo ikaingia kama maji ndani ya matumbo yake, na kama mafuta ndani ya mifupa yake.
sw.B: Alijivika laana kama nguo yake; ikapenya kama maji ndani ya utu wake wa ndani, ikaloweka kama mafuta mpaka ndani ya mifupa yake.
sw.R: Kulaani kulikuwa sehemu ya maisha yake, kama nguo alizovaa. Kulimjaa kama maji yanavyoloweka, kama mafuta yanavyozama ndani ya mifupa.

es.L: Y se vistió de maldición como de su vestido, y entró como agua en sus entrañas, y como aceite en sus huesos.
es.B: Se puso la maldición como su ropa; le penetró como agua hasta lo más hondo y empapó como aceite sus huesos.
es.R: Maldecir era parte de él, como la ropa que llevaba. Lo llenó como el agua que empapa, como el aceite que penetra hasta los huesos.

vi.L: Và hắn đã mặc lấy sự rủa sả như áo của hắn, và nó đã thấm như nước vào trong lòng hắn, và như dầu vào xương cốt hắn.
vi.B: Hắn khoác sự rủa sả như áo mặc; nó thấm như nước vào tận lòng hắn, và ngấm như dầu vào sâu trong xương cốt hắn.
vi.R: Sự nguyền rủa đã trở thành một phần của hắn, như quần áo hắn mặc. Nó thấm vào hắn như nước thấm vào, như dầu ngấm sâu vào xương.

decisions.choice: put on cursing like a garment: it became part of him
decisions.reason: What a person wears shows what he is (35:26; 73:6). Cursing was as close to him as his clothes.

decisions.choice: like oil into his bones: soaking right through
decisions.reason: Oil rubbed on the skin sinks in. The curse he loved has filled him through and through.

decisions.choice: it came: as in verse 17
decisions.reason: As in verse 17, the verbs say what has happened; the ancient translations read them as wishes.

source.text: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹכְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let it be to him like a garment [that] he wraps himself, and for a belt [that] continually he girds on.

en.L: Let it be to him like a garment [that] he wraps around himself, and like a belt [that] he continually ties on.
en.B: May it be the cloak he wraps around him, the belt he ties on every day.
en.R: Let his curses cover him like a coat and stay tied around him like a belt he never takes off.

fr.L: Qu’elle soit pour lui comme un vêtement [dont] il s’enveloppe, et comme une ceinture [qu’]il attache continuellement.
fr.B: Qu’elle soit le manteau dont il s’enveloppe, la ceinture qu’il attache chaque jour.
fr.R: Que ses malédictions le couvrent comme un manteau et restent attachées autour de lui comme une ceinture qu’il n’enlève jamais.

sw.L: Na iwe kwake kama vazi analojifunika, na kama mshipi anaojifunga daima.
sw.B: Na iwe joho analojifunika, mshipi anaojifunga kila siku.
sw.R: Laana zake na zimfunike kama koti, na zibaki zimemfunga kama mshipi asiouvua kamwe.

es.L: Que sea para él como vestido [con que] se envuelve, y como cinturón [que] continuamente se ciñe.
es.B: Que sea el manto que lo envuelve, el cinturón que se ciñe cada día.
es.R: Que sus maldiciones lo cubran como un abrigo y se le queden atadas como un cinturón que nunca se quita.

vi.L: Nguyện nó là cho hắn như cái áo hắn quấn quanh mình, và như cái thắt lưng hắn luôn luôn buộc vào.
vi.B: Nguyện nó là chiếc áo choàng hắn quấn quanh mình, là sợi thắt lưng hắn buộc mỗi ngày.
vi.R: Xin để những lời nguyền rủa của hắn phủ trên hắn như chiếc áo khoác, và bám chặt quanh hắn như sợi thắt lưng hắn không bao giờ cởi ra.

decisions.choice: let it be: the cursing of verse 18
decisions.reason: The cursing he put on is to stay on him for good.

decisions.choice: belt: a waistband
decisions.reason: The word (meziach) is a belt or sash, worn every day and seldom taken off.

decisions.choice: his curses
decisions.reason: Readable says what "it" is (m1).

source.text: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is the] wages of my accusers from YHWH, and of those who speak evil against my soul.

en.L: This [is] the wages of my accusers from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and of those who speak evil against my soul.
en.B: May this be how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} repays my accusers, those who speak evil against me.
en.R: Let this be the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pays back the people who accuse me and tell evil lies about me.

fr.L: Voilà le salaire de mes accusateurs, [venant] {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et de ceux qui disent du mal contre mon âme.
fr.B: Que ce soit ainsi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} paie mes accusateurs, ceux qui disent du mal contre moi.
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} paie de cette façon ceux qui m’accusent et qui racontent des mensonges méchants sur moi.

sw.L: Huu [ndio] ujira wa washtaki wangu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wa wale wanaosema mabaya dhidi ya nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awalipe washtaki wangu, wale wanaosema mabaya dhidi yangu.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awalipe watu wanaonishtaki na kunisemea uongo mbaya.

es.L: Este [sea] el pago de mis acusadores de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y de los que hablan mal contra mi alma.
es.B: Que así pague {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a mis acusadores, a los que hablan mal contra mí.
es.R: Que de esta manera {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les pague a los que me acusan y dicen mentiras malvadas sobre mí.

vi.L: Đây [là] tiền công từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho những kẻ cáo buộc tôi, và cho những kẻ nói điều ác nghịch cùng linh hồn tôi.
vi.B: Nguyện đó là cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} báo trả những kẻ cáo buộc tôi, những kẻ nói điều ác nghịch cùng tôi.
vi.R: Xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} báo trả như vậy cho những kẻ tố cáo tôi và nói những lời dối trá độc ác về tôi.

decisions.choice: this: all of verses 6-19
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the prayer for judgment: this is to be the pay the accusers receive from the LORD. It ends the section on judgment (verses 6-20).

decisions.choice: wages: what is earned
decisions.reason: The word (pe'ullah) is the pay for work done; they will receive what their deeds have earned.

decisions.choice: my accusers
decisions.reason: The same word (satan) as in verses 4 and 6.

decisions.choice: against me
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole self; Balanced and Readable say "me".

source.text: וְאַתָּ֤ה׀יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, YHWH [the] Lord, act with me for [the] sake of your name; for good [is] your loyal love, deliver me.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} my Lord, deal with me for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love [is] good, deliver me.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, take my side for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; rescue me, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love is good.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, help me, so that people will honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. Your faithful love is good, so rescue me!

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, mon Seigneur, agis envers moi à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal [est] bon, délivre-moi.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, prends mon parti pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; délivre-moi, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est bon.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, aide-moi, pour que les gens honorent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Ton amour fidèle est bon, alors délivre-moi !

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} Bwana wangu, unitendee kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma [ni] mwema, uniokoe.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, unisimamie kwa heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; uniokoe, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mwema.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, unisaidie, ili watu waliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mwema, basi uniokoe!

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor, actúa conmigo por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; porque bueno [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, líbrame.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, ponte de mi lado por el honor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; líbrame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel es bueno.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, ayúdame, para que la gente honre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Tu amor fiel es bueno, ¡así que rescátame!

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của tôi, xin đối xử với tôi vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] tốt lành, xin giải cứu tôi.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin bênh vực tôi vì danh dự của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin giải cứu tôi, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giúp đỡ tôi để người ta tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành, vậy xin giải cứu tôi!

decisions.choice: but you: the prayer turns
decisions.reason: After the prayer for judgment, the psalmist turns to God for himself. The stressed "you" sets God against the accusers.

decisions.choice: YHWH the Lord: the name with 'Adonai
decisions.reason: The name comes first, then "my Lord" ('Adonai), as in 68:21 and 140:8.

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord (L); Lord GOD (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 68:21: where the name stands with "Lord", it is written GOD so that the two are not read as "Lord Lord"; Balanced and Readable use the familiar order.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name: for your honor
decisions.reason: God's name is his known character; to act for its sake is to act so that he is known as faithful (23:3; 79:9).

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: As in 107:1.

decisions.choice: so that people will honor your name
alternatives: for the sake of your name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m4).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: "DIEU, mon Seigneur" (Literal) and "Seigneur DIEU" (Balanced, Readable), with "Yahvé" as the alternative for the name
decisions.reason: Where the name stands beside Adonai, French writes the name as "DIEU" in capitals so that "Seigneur" is not doubled, as the Pentateuch's "le Seigneur DIEU" does.

decisions.choice: "MUNGU Bwana wangu" at Literal, in the Hebrew order; "Bwana MUNGU" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The name YHWH comes before "my Lord" here. Literal keeps that order, with the name in capitals as "MUNGU" (since "BWANA Bwana" would repeat one word); Balanced and Readable use the usual Swahili pairing "Bwana MUNGU", as for Adonai YHWH elsewhere.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor (L); Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name YHWH stands with ʾAdonai, "Lord". As in the books of Moses, the name next to "Señor" is "DIOS" in capitals, so that "Señor SEÑOR" is not written. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, name first; Balanced and Readable use the usual "Señor DIOS", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA, Chúa của tôi" (L); "Chúa là CHÚA" (B, R) for the name with Adonai, as Psalm 69:7
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot set the two words side by side as English can ("Lord GOD"); "là" joins the title to the name, as in Psalm 69:7. "Chúa" for Adonai stays in lowercase, "CHÚA" for the name in capitals. |

source.text: כִּֽי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For poor and needy [am] I, and my heart is pierced within me.

en.L: For poor and needy [am] I, and my heart is pierced within me.
en.B: For I am poor and helpless; my heart within me is pierced through.
en.R: I am poor, and I need help. My heart is broken and full of pain.

fr.L: Car pauvre et indigent [je suis], moi, et mon cœur est transpercé au-dedans de moi.
fr.B: Car je suis pauvre et sans défense ; mon cœur est transpercé au fond de moi.
fr.R: Je suis pauvre, et j’ai besoin d’aide. Mon cœur est brisé et plein de douleur.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi [ni] maskini na mhitaji, na moyo wangu umechomwa ndani yangu.
sw.B: Kwa maana mimi ni maskini na mnyonge; moyo wangu ndani yangu umechomwa.
sw.R: Mimi ni maskini, nami nahitaji msaada. Moyo wangu umevunjika na umejaa maumivu.

es.L: Porque pobre y necesitado [soy] yo, y mi corazón está traspasado dentro de mí.
es.B: Porque soy pobre y estoy desamparado; mi corazón está herido dentro de mí.
es.R: Soy pobre y necesito ayuda. Tengo el corazón roto y lleno de dolor.

vi.L: Vì nghèo khó và thiếu thốn [là] tôi, và lòng tôi bị đâm thủng trong tôi.
vi.B: Vì tôi nghèo khổ và không nơi nương tựa; lòng tôi bị đâm thấu bên trong.
vi.R: Tôi nghèo khổ, và tôi cần được giúp đỡ. Lòng tôi tan nát và đầy đau đớn.

decisions.choice: poor and needy: the one the enemy hunted
decisions.reason: The psalmist is the "poor and needy" whom the enemy pursued to death (verse 16).

decisions.choice: pierced: wounded
decisions.reason: The verb (chalal) is to pierce or wound: grief and hurt have stabbed him to the heart.

decisions.choice: my heart is broken and full of pain
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

source.text: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Like a shadow when it stretches out I have gone; I have been shaken off like the locust.

en.L: Like a shadow when it stretches out, I have gone; I have been shaken off like the locust.
en.B: Like a shadow lengthening at dusk I pass away; I am brushed off like a locust.
en.R: I am disappearing like a shadow at the end of the day. People shake me off like a locust on their clothes.

fr.L: Comme l’ombre quand elle s’allonge, je m’en vais ; je suis secoué comme la sauterelle.
fr.B: Comme une ombre qui s’allonge le soir, je disparais ; on me chasse d’un revers comme une sauterelle.
fr.R: Je disparais comme une ombre à la fin du jour. Les gens me secouent comme une sauterelle tombée sur leurs habits.

sw.L: Kama kivuli kinaporefuka nimetoweka; nimekung'utwa kama nzige.
sw.B: Kama kivuli kinachorefuka jioni ninapita; nimepeperushwa mbali kama nzige.
sw.R: Ninatoweka kama kivuli mwisho wa siku. Watu wananikung'uta kama nzige aliyetua kwenye nguo zao.

es.L: Como sombra cuando se alarga, me he ido; he sido sacudido como la langosta.
es.B: Como sombra que se alarga al atardecer me voy; me sacuden como a una langosta.
es.R: Estoy desapareciendo como la sombra al final del día. La gente me sacude de encima como a una langosta que cae en la ropa.

vi.L: Như cái bóng khi nó ngả dài, tôi đã qua đi; tôi đã bị rũ bỏ như con cào cào.
vi.B: Như bóng chiều đang ngả dài, tôi đang qua đi; tôi bị phủi đi như một con cào cào.
vi.R: Tôi đang biến mất như cái bóng lúc cuối ngày. Người ta phủi tôi đi như phủi một con cào cào bám trên áo.

decisions.choice: a shadow when it stretches out: evening coming on
decisions.reason: A long shadow means the day is ending; soon it will vanish. The picture is of a life near its end (102:12; 144:4).

decisions.choice: shaken off like a locust: brushed off as worthless
decisions.reason: A locust that lands on clothing is shaken off without a thought; locusts were also swept away by the wind (Exodus 10:19).

decisions.choice: People; on their clothes
decisions.reason: Readable says who shakes him off and from where (m2).

source.text: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: My knees have stumbled from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean from fat.

en.L: My knees have stumbled from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean, without fat.
en.B: My knees buckle from going without food, and my body has grown thin, with no fat left on it.
en.R: I have gone without food for so long that my knees are weak. I have become skin and bones.

fr.L: Mes genoux chancellent à cause du jeûne, et ma chair a maigri, sans graisse.
fr.B: Mes genoux fléchissent parce que je ne mange plus, et mon corps a maigri, il ne lui reste plus de graisse.
fr.R: Je suis resté si longtemps sans manger que mes genoux sont faibles. Je n’ai plus que la peau sur les os.

sw.L: Magoti yangu yamelegea kwa kufunga, na mwili wangu umekonda, bila mafuta.
sw.B: Magoti yangu yanalegea kwa kukaa bila chakula, na mwili wangu umekonda, hauna mafuta tena.
sw.R: Nimekaa bila chakula kwa muda mrefu hata magoti yangu yamekuwa dhaifu. Nimebaki ngozi na mifupa.

es.L: Mis rodillas han flaqueado por el ayuno, y mi carne ha enflaquecido, sin grasa.
es.B: Las rodillas se me doblan de tanto ayunar, y mi cuerpo ha adelgazado hasta no tener grasa.
es.R: He pasado tanto tiempo sin comer que tengo las rodillas débiles. Me he quedado en los huesos.

vi.L: Đầu gối tôi đã lảo đảo vì kiêng ăn, và thân thể tôi đã gầy mòn, không còn mỡ.
vi.B: Đầu gối tôi khuỵu xuống vì nhịn ăn, và thân thể tôi gầy đi, chẳng còn chút mỡ nào.
vi.R: Tôi đã nhịn ăn lâu đến nỗi đầu gối tôi yếu đi. Tôi chỉ còn da bọc xương.

decisions.choice: fasting: going without food in grief and prayer
decisions.reason: People fasted when they mourned or prayed in great need (35:13; 69:11).

decisions.choice: lean from fat: wasted away
decisions.reason: The words mean his body has lost its fat. They may also mean "without oil": he has not anointed himself, as mourners did not (2 Samuel 14:2).

decisions.choice: I have become skin and bones
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain picture with the same sense.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have become a reproach to them; they see me, they shake their head.

en.L: And I have become a reproach to them; they see me, they shake their head.
en.B: They treat me with contempt; when they catch sight of me, they shake their heads at me.
en.R: People laugh at me. They see me and shake their heads to mock me.

fr.L: Et moi, je suis devenu pour eux un objet d’insulte ; ils me voient, ils hochent la tête.
fr.B: Ils me traitent avec mépris ; quand ils m’aperçoivent, ils hochent la tête contre moi.
fr.R: Les gens se moquent de moi. Ils me voient et secouent la tête pour se moquer.

sw.L: Nami nimekuwa aibu kwao; wanionapo, wanatikisa kichwa chao.
sw.B: Wananidharau; wanaponiona, wananitikisia vichwa vyao.
sw.R: Watu wananicheka. Wananiona na kutikisa vichwa vyao kunidhihaki.

es.L: Y yo he llegado a ser un oprobio para ellos; me ven, menean su cabeza.
es.B: Me tratan con desprecio; cuando me ven, menean la cabeza contra mí.
es.R: La gente se ríe de mí. Me ven y menean la cabeza para burlarse.

vi.L: Và tôi đã trở thành sự nhục nhã cho chúng; chúng thấy tôi, chúng lắc đầu.
vi.B: Chúng đối xử với tôi đầy khinh miệt; khi thấy tôi, chúng lắc đầu chế nhạo.
vi.R: Người ta cười nhạo tôi. Họ thấy tôi và lắc đầu chế giễu tôi.

decisions.choice: shake the head: mock
decisions.reason: Shaking the head was a gesture of scorn (22:8; 44:15). Those who passed by the cross shook their heads at Jesus (Matthew 27:39).

decisions.choice: a reproach: one who is scorned
decisions.reason: The word (cherpah) is disgrace, and a person treated with contempt (22:7).

decisions.choice: They treat me with contempt (B); People laugh at me (R)
alternatives: I have become a reproach to them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say it from the side of those who scorn him.

source.text: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Help me, YHWH my God; save me according to your loyal love.

en.L: Help me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God; save me according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, come to my help! Save me, true to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, help me! Save me, as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love promises.

fr.L: Aide-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu ; sauve-moi selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, viens à mon secours ! Sauve-moi, fidèle à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, aide-moi ! Sauve-moi, comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle le promet.

sw.L: Unisaidie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu; uniokoe kwa kadiri ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, njoo unisaidie! Uniokoe, kama upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ulivyo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, unisaidie! Uniokoe, kama upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unavyoahidi.

es.L: Ayúdame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío; sálvame conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, ¡ven en mi ayuda! Sálvame, fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, ¡ayúdame! Sálvame, como lo promete {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel.

vi.L: Xin giúp tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi; xin cứu tôi theo tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, xin đến giúp tôi! Xin cứu tôi, đúng như tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, xin giúp tôi! Xin cứu tôi, như tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: As in 107:1 and verse 21.

decisions.choice: according to your loyal love: as your love would do
decisions.reason: God's loyal love is the measure of his help, and the ground of the plea.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

source.text: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And let them know that your hand [is] this; you, YHWH, you have done it.

en.L: And let them know that this [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have done it.
en.B: Make them see that this is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hand at work, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are the one who did it.
en.R: Then my enemies will know that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did this, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}. They will see that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power saved me.

fr.L: Et qu’ils sachent que c’[est] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main ; {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as fait.
fr.B: Fais-leur voir que c’est {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main qui agit, que c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui l’as fait.
fr.R: Alors mes ennemis sauront que c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait cela, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils verront que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance m’a sauvé.

sw.L: Na wajue kwamba huu [ni] mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umelitenda.
sw.B: Uwafanye waone kwamba huu ni mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaofanya kazi, kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiwe uliyelitenda.
sw.R: Ndipo adui zangu watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe uliyefanya hivi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wataona kwamba nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ndizo zilizoniokoa.

es.L: Y que sepan que esta [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo has hecho.
es.B: Haz que vean que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propia mano la que actúa, que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres quien lo hizo.
es.R: Así mis enemigos sabrán que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste esto, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Verán que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder me salvó.

vi.L: Và nguyện chúng biết rằng đây [là] tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã làm điều đó.
vi.B: Xin cho chúng thấy rằng đây là chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hành động, rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng đã làm điều ấy.
vi.R: Bấy giờ kẻ thù tôi sẽ biết rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm điều này, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chúng sẽ thấy quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu tôi.

decisions.choice: your hand: your power at work
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and action (107:2). His rescue is to be so plain that the enemies see God did it.

decisions.choice: you, you have done it: stressed
decisions.reason: The pronoun is repeated: it is God and no one else who acted.

decisions.choice: my enemies; saved me
decisions.reason: Readable names who will know and what God's hand did.

source.text: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ׀וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them curse, they, but you will bless; they have arisen and been shamed, but your servant will rejoice.

en.L: Let them curse, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will bless; they have risen up and been put to shame, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant will rejoice.
en.B: They may curse, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will bless; when they rise against me they will be disgraced, while {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant rejoices.
en.R: They may curse me, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will bless me. They attack me, but they will end up ashamed, and I, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, will be glad.

fr.L: Qu’ils maudissent, eux, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} béniras ; ils se sont levés et ont été couverts de honte, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur se réjouira.
fr.B: Ils peuvent maudire, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} béniras ; quand ils se dresseront contre moi, ils seront couverts de honte, tandis que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur se réjouira.
fr.R: Ils peuvent me maudire, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me béniras. Ils m’attaquent, mais ils finiront couverts de honte, et moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, je serai dans la joie.

sw.L: Wao na walaani, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utabariki; wameinuka na kuaibishwa, lakini mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} atafurahi.
sw.B: Wao waweza kulaani, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utabariki; wanaponiinukia wataaibika, lakini mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} atafurahi.
sw.R: Waweza kunilaani, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utanibariki. Wananishambulia, lakini mwishowe wataaibika, nami, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nitafurahi.

es.L: Que maldigan ellos, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} bendecirás; se levantaron y fueron avergonzados, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo se alegrará.
es.B: Ellos podrán maldecir, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} bendecirás; cuando se levanten contra mí quedarán en vergüenza, mientras {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo se alegra.
es.R: Puede que ellos me maldigan, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me bendecirás. Me atacan, pero acabarán avergonzados, y yo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, estaré contento.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng rủa sả, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc phước; chúng đã nổi lên và đã bị hổ thẹn, và đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui mừng.
vi.B: Chúng có rủa sả, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc phước; khi chúng nổi lên chống tôi, chúng sẽ bị hổ nhục, còn đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì vui mừng.
vi.R: Chúng có thể nguyền rủa tôi, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc phước cho tôi. Chúng tấn công tôi, nhưng rốt cuộc chúng sẽ bị xấu hổ, còn tôi, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ vui mừng.

decisions.choice: they curse, you bless
decisions.reason: The key words of verses 17-18 come back: human curses cannot stand against God's blessing (Numbers 23:8; Genesis 12:3).

decisions.choice: they have arisen and been shamed: as good as done
alternatives: let those who rise against me be put to shame (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The verbs are past in form, but they describe what is sure to happen: when they rise up, they will be put to shame. The ancient Greek translation reads a wish.

decisions.choice: when they rise against me they will be disgraced (B); they will end up ashamed (R)
alternatives: they have arisen and been ashamed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the verbs (m2).

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: Readable says whom they curse and God blesses.

decisions.choice: tu siervo
decisions.reason: When the psalmist calls himself God's servant, the English Literal too says "servant": he speaks of belonging to God and serving him, not of slavery. So "tu siervo" is used at every level, as in the other psalms.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Ngài" for the singer's name for himself, at every level, as Psalm 27:9
decisions.reason: The earlier Psalms keep "đầy tớ" for "your servant" at every level. |

source.text: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let my accusers be clothed [with] disgrace, and let them wrap themselves like the robe [in] their shame.

en.L: Let my accusers be clothed [with] disgrace, and let them wrap themselves in their shame as [in] a robe.
en.B: May my accusers be dressed in dishonor and wrapped in their own shame like a cloak.
en.R: Let the people who accuse me be covered with disgrace. Let their shame wrap around them like a coat.

fr.L: Que mes accusateurs soient revêtus [d’]opprobre, et qu’ils s’enveloppent de leur honte comme [d’]un manteau.
fr.B: Que mes accusateurs soient habillés de déshonneur et enveloppés de leur propre honte comme d’un manteau.
fr.R: Que ceux qui m’accusent soient couverts de honte. Que leur honte les enveloppe comme un manteau.

sw.L: Washtaki wangu na wavikwe aibu, na wajifunike fedheha yao kama [kwa] joho.
sw.B: Washtaki wangu na wavikwe fedheha na kujifunika aibu yao wenyewe kama joho.
sw.R: Watu wanaonishtaki na wafunikwe na aibu. Fedheha yao na iwazunguke kama koti.

es.L: Que mis acusadores se vistan [de] deshonra, y se envuelvan en su vergüenza como [en] un manto.
es.B: Que mis acusadores queden vestidos de deshonra y envueltos en su propia vergüenza como en una capa.
es.R: Que las personas que me acusan queden cubiertas de deshonra. Que su vergüenza las envuelva como un abrigo.

vi.L: Nguyện những kẻ cáo buộc tôi bị mặc lấy sự ô nhục, và nguyện chúng quấn mình trong sự hổ thẹn của chúng như [trong] áo choàng.
vi.B: Nguyện những kẻ cáo buộc tôi phải mặc lấy nhục nhã và quấn mình trong chính sự hổ thẹn của chúng như chiếc áo choàng.
vi.R: Xin để những kẻ tố cáo tôi bị phủ đầy nhục nhã. Xin để sự xấu hổ quấn quanh chúng như chiếc áo khoác.

decisions.choice: clothed with shame: the cursing they wore
decisions.reason: As the enemy put on cursing like a garment (verses 18-19), the accusers are to wear their own shame (35:26).

decisions.choice: my accusers
decisions.reason: The same word (satan) as in verses 4, 6 and 20.

source.text: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will thank YHWH exceedingly with my mouth, and in [the] midst of many I will praise him.

en.L: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} exceedingly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: My lips will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over and over; I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the middle of the crowd.
en.R: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} out loud, again and again. I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in front of many people.

fr.L: Je rendrai grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} hautement de ma bouche, et au milieu de la multitude je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai.
fr.B: Mes lèvres rendront grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} encore et encore ; je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai au milieu de la foule.
fr.R: Je remercierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à voix haute, encore et encore. Je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai devant beaucoup de gens.

sw.L: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sana kwa kinywa changu, na katikati ya wengi nitamsifu.
sw.B: Midomo yangu itamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tena na tena; nitamsifu katikati ya umati.
sw.R: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sauti, tena na tena. Nitamsifu mbele ya watu wengi.

es.L: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en gran manera con mi boca, y en medio de muchos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} alabaré.
es.B: Mis labios darán gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una y otra vez; {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} alabaré en medio de la multitud.
es.R: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en voz alta, una y otra vez. Delante de mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} alabaré.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ hết sức cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng miệng tôi, và giữa nhiều người tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Môi miệng tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không ngớt; tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa đám đông.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ lớn tiếng cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hết lần này đến lần khác. Tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mặt nhiều người.

decisions.choice: in the midst of many: thanks in public
decisions.reason: Thanks for a rescue was given aloud before the gathered people (22:23, 26; 35:18).

decisions.choice: exceedingly: greatly, fully
decisions.reason: The word (me'od) makes the thanks great and wholehearted.

decisions.choice: my lips
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the more natural picture for speaking praise.

source.text: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he stands at [the] right hand of [the] needy, to save [him] from those who judge his soul.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stands at the right hand of the needy, to save [{{gender:them|him}}] from those who judge {{gender:their|his}} soul.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place at the right side of the needy, to save them from those who would sentence them to death.
en.R: He stands right beside people in need. He saves them from those who want them condemned to death.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se tient à la droite du pauvre, pour [le] sauver de ceux qui jugent son âme.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend place à la droite de l’indigent, pour le sauver de ceux qui voudraient le condamner à mort.
fr.R: Il se tient tout près de ceux qui sont dans le besoin. Il les sauve de ceux qui veulent les faire condamner à mort.

sw.L: Kwa maana husimama mkono wa kuume wa mhitaji, ili amwokoe kutoka kwa wale wanaoihukumu nafsi yake.
sw.B: Kwa maana husimama upande wa kuume wa mhitaji, ili awaokoe na wale ambao wangewahukumu kufa.
sw.R: Husimama kando ya watu wenye shida. Huwaokoa na wale wanaotaka wahukumiwe kufa.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se pone a la derecha del necesitado, para salvar[lo] de los que juzgan su alma.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ocupa {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar al lado derecho del necesitado, para salvarlo de los que quieren condenarlo a muerte.
es.R: Él está junto a las personas necesitadas. Las salva de los que quieren que las condenen a muerte.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng bên tay phải người thiếu thốn, để cứu [người ấy] khỏi những kẻ kết án linh hồn người ấy.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng bên phải người thiếu thốn, để cứu họ khỏi những kẻ muốn kết án tử họ.
vi.R: Ngài đứng ngay bên cạnh những người đang cần giúp đỡ. Ngài cứu họ khỏi những kẻ muốn họ bị kết án tử hình.

decisions.choice: at the right hand of the needy: the defender's place
decisions.reason: The accuser stood at the right hand of the accused (verse 6). Here God himself stands at the right hand of the needy as defender, and the case turns.

decisions.choice: those who judge his soul: those who condemn him to death
decisions.reason: To judge someone's soul (nefesh) is to pass sentence on his life.

decisions.choice: them, their (him, his)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the needy as "him"; the default says "them", with "him" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: the needy ... them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of the needy as a group, which includes men and women alike.

decisions.choice: "le" and "son" with no setting, where the English Literal has "them, their (him, his)"
decisions.reason: The needy here is anyone in need; French generic "le pauvre ... le" already includes women, so no setting is put on the pronouns, as the French style guide sets.

decisions.choice: salvar[lo] ... su alma (no gender setting)
alternatives: a gender setting on the pronouns
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender setting on "them, their / him, his". Spanish "su" names no gender, and "lo" refers back to "el necesitado", a noun that covers anyone in need, so Spanish needs no setting here.

decisions.choice: "người ấy" (that person) at Literal, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "them, their" or "him, his"; "người ấy" means a man or a woman, so Vietnamese has no second form. |
